messages:
rita: Thinking out loud 1: we keep getting noisy rollouts because dry-run results live only in CI artifacts. Can we add a runtime 'shadow mirror' that applies config changes to a mirrored cohort in prod (no-op for routing/quotas) but captures metrics and evaluator diffs?
noah: conceptually like a traffic mirror but for config effects only. Good for endpoint-level regressions that our unit tests miss.
dev-ops-bot: feature-flag shadow-mirror created: id=shadow-2026-03-18T10:00 (defaults: sample=1%, retention=2h)
hannah: two immediate questions: (1) how do we guarantee it's non-invasive? e.g., quotas/usage must not be consumed, side effects blocked. (2) UI/observability - we need a simple 'safety delta' in console showing what would change (latency, fallbacks, error-rate) before promoting.
zack: design idea: run mirrored evaluation in the routing layer with a 'dry' modifier. Requests go through normal pipeline; a copy of request context is passed to a shadow evaluator that uses the candidate config and emits metrics to a shadow telemetry stream (tagged `shadow_id`). No external calls should be allowed from shadow path; if code attempts side-effect, assert and log.
rita: API sketch: `POST /admin/shadows` body: `{ "configDelta": <config-json>, "samplePct": 1, "durationMin": 120, "blockSideEffects": true }` returns shadow_id.
noah: runtime changes: (A) add a fast-path in router to fork context into shadow worker (async), (B) ensure quota-metering uses a virtual meter for shadow traces so real quotas unaffected, (C) sandbox outbound calls via a whitelist or stubbing layer.
hannah: UX: add panel in Console -> Config Preview showing shadow runs: histogram of `latency_delta_ms`, `fallback_delta_pct`, `err_delta_pct` per-tenant sampled. Also a safety score computed from weighted thresholds.
zack: safety-score formula proposal: score = 100 - clamp( 50*err_delta_pct + 0.2*latency_delta_ms + 100*fallback_delta_pct, 0, 100 ). We can surface top 5 offending tenants.
rita: rollout plan: (1) internal dry-run in staging with full 100% sample (2) create shadow run in prod at 0.1% for 6h (3) increase to 1% for 12h and run automatic safety checks, (4) if score >= 95 and no tenant > err_delta_pct 0.2%, mark safe to canary.
noah: automation: add `POST /admin/shadows/{id}/promote?target=canary&canary_pct=5` that will create a canary rollout when conditions met. Also add `GET /admin/shadows/{id}/report` which returns precomputed summaries.
dev-ops-bot: alert rule suggestion: fire if any tenant shows fallback_delta_pct > 0.3% OR err_delta_pct > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes during shadow window.
hannah: telemetry needs: ensure shadow traces include full stack samples. For low-volume tenants bump sampling to 25% for duration of shadow. We'll need a transient sampling override in runtime config.
zack: implementation notes: we'll add a ShadowWorker service that subscribes to forked contexts, executes evaluation path in Rust sandbox with no network syscall facade, emits metrics to kafka.topic `shadow.metrics.v1`. ShadowWorker must be horizontally scalable and respect backpressure.
rita: security note: configs can include secrets (rare). Shadow runs must not log secret values. Mask any fields that match `secret`/`api_key` patterns in shadow payloads.
noah: ops handoff: PRs needed - router change (fork + virtual meter), shadow worker service, console UI, alert rules, promote endpoint. ETA rough: router + worker 3d, console + alerts 2d, promote automation 1d.
hannah: acceptance criteria: end-to-end shadow run in staging, production pilot (0.1%) with dashboard showing scores, a documented rollback/pause flow: `POST /admin/shadows/{id}/pause` which stops new shadow samples and a `POST /admin/shadows/{id}/retract` to delete results.
zack: small demo config example we'll use in PR: ```json {"feature":"route_by_cost_v2","weight":0.2,"quarantine_threshold":0.05} ```
rita: thanks all. Let's try to ship minimal MVP that blocks side-effects and provides per-tenant summaries. I'll open the umbrella ticket and assign tasks.
dev-ops-bot: ticket created: INF-2043 "shadow config preview MVP" (link: https://tracks.local/INF-2043)
noah: tagging @eng-sre for runbook once pilot starts.
hannah: will sketch console mockups tonight and post in the thread.
zack: will stub the Rust sandbox and post early perf numbers.
rita: nice work team. If we can catch subtle routing regressions earlier with shadowing, it will save a lot of oncall noise. :raised_hands:
